name: Create Foreign Exchange Option V 02
definition: Scope|The CreateForeignExchangeOption message is sent by a participant to a central system or to a counterparty to confirm a foreign currency option contract.|Usage|Both trading parties will send a notification to the central settlement system. The central settlement system will then send a ForeignExchangeOptionNotification to both.|This message is only suitable for Simple (i.e. not Barrier) Vanilla (i.e. not Binary, Digital, Notouch) Foreign Exchange Options.

TradeInformation.name: Trade Information
TradeInformation.definition: Provides identification and date of the foreign exchange option trade which is created.

TradingSideIdentification.name: Trading Side Identification
TradingSideIdentification.definition: Specifies the trading side of the currency option trade which is created.

CounterpartySideIdentification.name: Counterparty Side Identification
CounterpartySideIdentification.definition: Specifies the counterparty of the currency option trade which is created.

Option.name: Option
Option.definition: Specifies the parameters of the currency option which is sold by the trading side.
